← Paper Nest 紙材排料

Prototype support / 試作版支援範圍

A browser-based feasibility prototype for paper laser-cutting layouts. Files are processed in this browser and are not uploaded. Refreshing closes the drawing.
用於紙材 laser cut 嘅排料試作版。圖檔只喺瀏覽器內處理，不會上載；重新整理會清除目前圖檔。

Supported / 已支援

  • ASCII DXF: model-space XY geometry, LINE, ARC, CIRCLE and zero-width LWPOLYLINE, including bulges.
    ASCII DXF：Model Space XY 平面直線、圓弧、圓及零闊度 LWPOLYLINE，包含 bulge。
  • AutoCAD GROUP and simple uniformly scaled, unmirrored BLOCK/INSERT. Imported blocks are expanded; exported parts use GROUP.
    AutoCAD GROUP，以及等比、非鏡像嘅簡單 BLOCK／INSERT。匯入 block 會展開；輸出零件使用 GROUP。
  • SVG paths, rectangles, circles, ellipses, lines, polylines, polygons and nested transforms. Explicit dimensions are required; text and styles must be expanded.
    SVG 路徑、基本圖形及巢狀 transform；需要明確尺寸，文字及 styles 請先展開。
  • Closed boundaries assembled from matching endpoints, contained holes and open engraving; explicit groups take priority.
    由相同端點組成嘅封閉輪廓、內部孔洞及開放刻線；指定群組優先。
  • Irregular-outline nesting, multiple sheets, 15°/30°/90°/fixed rotation, part gap and sheet margin.
    不規則輪廓排料、多張板材、旋轉級距、零件間距及留邊。
  • DXF input → DXF or SVG; SVG input → SVG. Sheet guides are excluded from exports.
    DXF 輸入可匯出 DXF／SVG；SVG 輸入可匯出 SVG。板邊預覽線不會輸出。

Before cutting / 切割前

Confirm inferred part groups and a known physical dimension. Unsupported content is rejected rather than silently removed. The prototype does not guarantee the mathematical optimum. It does not place parts inside holes, merge cut lines, compensate kerf or generate machine toolpaths. A real AutoCAD round trip remains required for production approval.
請核對推斷分組及已知尺寸。不支援內容會拒絕匯入，不會略過。試作版不保證數學最佳解，亦未提供孔內排料、共線切割、kerf 補償或機器刀路。正式使用前仍需於 AutoCAD 完成實際往返驗證。

Collision curves are approximated to a nominal 0.02 mm tolerance, with additional clearance during nesting. Supported original DXF curves and original SVG shapes are retained for export. Disconnected explicit groups use a conservative envelope.
碰撞計算曲線使用名義 0.02 mm 精度，排料另加間隙。輸出保留受支援原始 DXF 曲線及 SVG 圖形。不相連嘅指定群組使用保守外邊界。

Limits: 5 MB, 80 parts and 3,000 entities per drawing; 30-second search. Very complex drawings may take longer to import.
上限：5 MB、80 件零件及 3,000 個圖元；每次排料搜尋 30 秒。複雜圖檔匯入可能較慢。

Open-source credits / 開源鳴謝

Nesting engine: SVGNest, Jack Qiao, MIT. Licence. Its bundled utilities retain their original notices, including Clipper, Parallel.js, SVGPathSeg and geometry utilities.
排料引擎採用 SVGNest；保留所有隨附程式庫嘅授權聲明。

SVG path measurement: path-data-polyfill by Jarosław Foksa, MIT; includes credited path normalisation utilities.

DXF indexed colour table: dxf-parser, MIT. Licence.
